F001.summary: Monorepo scaffold with Turborepo is properly configured

turbo.json configured with build, dev, c.detail: turbo.json has build, dev, lint, check-types, test, db:* tasks. No 'check' task — root package.json maps 'check' to 'turbo lint'. AC says 'check' but actual config has 'check-types' and 'lint' as separate tasks. Functionally equivalent but naming doesn't match AC literally.

Package workspaces defined in root packa.detail: Workspaces defined as ['apps/*', 'packages/*'] with catalog dependencies. 2 apps (server, web) and 6 packages (config, auth, env, db, types, api) found.

TypeScript project references working.detail: packages/types/tsconfig.json extends @nomos-ai/config/tsconfig.base.json with composite: true, declaration: true. Base config in packages/config/tsconfig.base.json is well-configured with strict mode, ESNext target, bundler resolution.

bun run dev starts all apps concurrently.detail: Root package.json has 'dev': 'turbo dev'. turbo.json configures dev as persistent with no cache. Both apps have dev scripts: server uses 'bun run --hot src/index.ts', web uses 'vite dev'. Turborepo handles concurrent execution.

issues.description: AC says 'check pipelines' but turbo.json has 'check-types' and 'lint' as separate tasks instead of a single 'check' task

F002.summary: Shared types package with branded types is well-implemented with comprehensive Zod schemas

Branded types prevent mixing IDs at comp.detail: ids.ts defines branded types using Zod .brand<>() for FeatureId, ProjectId, SessionId, UserId, WorktreeId, EventId, MessageId, NotificationId, SettingId. Test at ids.test.ts:128-135 uses @ts-expect-error to verify compile-time type safety between FeatureId and ProjectId.

Zod schemas validate runtime data.detail: FeatureIdSchema uses regex ^F[0-9]{3}$ for runtime validation. ProjectIdSchema uses ^P[0-9]{3}$. SessionIdSchema and UserIdSchema are string-only (no regex). All schemas use safeParse for runtime validation tested in ids.test.ts.

Types importable from @nomos/types.detail: Package named @nomos-ai/types (not @nomos/types but consistent with project namespace). package.json exports '.': './src/index.ts' and './*': './src/*.ts'. index.ts re-exports all types from all modules. Root package.json has '@nomos-ai/types': 'workspace:*' as dependency.

Constants exported for status enums.detail: FEATURE_STATUS, PROJECT_STATUS, SESSION_STATUS constants exported from status.ts with 'as const' for compile-time literal types. ESTIMATED_SIZE, MODEL, THINKING_LEVEL, PLANNING_MODE, etc. also exported from feature.ts. All re-exported via index.ts.

F003.summary: Feature Zod schema with comprehensive validation — all ACs met with thorough test coverage

Schema validates all required fields.detail: FeatureSchema requires: id (FeatureIdSchema), title (string 5-80), category (CategoryIdSchema), description (string 20-500), phase (PhaseIdSchema), acceptanceCriteria (array 1-10), status (FeatureStatusSchema), passes (boolean). Tests verify rejection of missing/invalid required fields.

Status enum matches state machine.detail: FeatureStatusSchema accepts exactly 6 values: backlog, pending, in_progress, waiting_approval, verified, failed. Matches the NOMOS state machine documented in CLAUDE.md. FEATURE_VALID_TRANSITIONS defines valid state transitions. Test verifies exactly 6 statuses.

Feature ID pattern validated (F001-F999).detail: FeatureIdSchema uses regex ^F[0-9]{3}$ with brand<'FeatureId'>. Tests verify F001, F123, F999 accepted; rejects F0001, F00, F1, f001, A001, numbers, objects, null, undefined.

Type inference works correctly.detail: Feature type is inferred via z.infer<typeof FeatureSchema>. Test at feature.test.ts:406-411 verifies type inference works. Branded types are properly inferred through the schema chain.

F004.summary: Project schema is well-implemented but test data uses invalid ID format — tests should be FAILING

Schema validates project structure.detail: ProjectSchema validates id (ProjectIdSchema), name (1-100), path (absolute path), settings (optional with defaults), status (default 'draft'), createdAt/updatedAt (datetime).

Path validation ensures valid directory.detail: Path uses .refine() to check startsWith('/') or Windows drive letter /^[A-Za-z]:/ pattern. Tests verify rejection of empty, relative, and dot-relative paths. Windows paths accepted.

Settings object typed correctly.detail: ProjectSettingsSchema has theme (enum light/dark/system), locale (string), autoSaveInterval (int min 0), notifications (boolean). All have defaults. Transform merges partial settings with defaults.

Timestamps validated as ISO strings.detail: createdAt and updatedAt use z.string().datetime() which enforces ISO 8601 format. Tests verify rejection of 'not-a-date' and '2026-01-28' (missing time), acceptance of Z suffix timestamps.

issues.description: Test fixture uses id: 'proj-001' but ProjectIdSchema requires ^P[0-9]{3}$ format (e.g., 'P001'). The test 'accepts minimal valid project' at line 77 should FAIL. This affects 14+ test cases that use the same minimalValidProject fixture. Either tests are not being run or this was never caught.

F005.summary: Session schema properly validates lifecycle with all ACs met, minor inconsistency in timestamp handling

Schema validates session lifecycle.detail: SessionSchema validates id (SessionIdSchema), featureId (FeatureIdSchema), status (SessionStatusSchema), startedAt (date), optional completedAt, output, error. F258 additions include sdkSessionId, model, isRunning, workingDirectory, messageCount.

Status tracks pending/running/completed/.detail: SESSION_STATUS defines exactly 4 values: pending, running, completed, failed. SessionStatusSchema validates against these. SESSION_VALID_TRANSITIONS defines valid transitions. Tests verify all 4 statuses and reject old values (active, paused).

Output stores agent response.detail: output field is z.string().optional(). Tests verify completed session can store output string.

Timestamps track duration.detail: startedAt (required, z.coerce.date()) and completedAt (optional, z.coerce.date()) track duration. Tests verify lifecycle: pending has no completedAt, running has no completedAt, completed/failed can have completedAt.

issues.description: Session uses z.coerce.date() for timestamps while Project (F004) uses z.string().datetime(). Coerce accepts loose formats (epoch numbers, various date strings). Not broken but inconsistent API surface — session dates are Date objects while project dates are ISO strings.

critical_issues: F004: Test fixture uses 'proj-001' but schema requires P[0-9]{3} format — 14+ tests should be failing
